name: @nexus/memory-daemon
description: Standalone local memory daemon for Nexus + OpenClaw. Markdown-canonical vault, rebuildable SQLite index (sqlite-vec + FTS5), local llama retrieval stack.
comment:overrides: find-my-way ^9.7.0 clears GHSA-c96f-x56v-gq3h (HTTP/2 DDoS in <=9.6.0), reached transitively through fastify. The daemon installs standalone (--no-workspaces), so the root override does not apply here — this mirrors it. Drop once fastify ships a lockfile carrying >=9.7.0. @hono/node-server ^2.0.5 clears GHSA-frvp-7c67-39w9 (path traversal in serve-static): it arrives via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, whose 1.30.0 now declares `^1.19.9 || ^2.0.5`, so lifting the floor to the patched 2.0.5 stays within the SDK's range. The daemon speaks MCP over stdio only and never loads the node-server adapter, so this is defence-in-depth. Drop once the SDK's lockfile carries >=2.0.5 itself.
